name: Writhing Haunt
summary: The Writhing Haunt is a blighted farmstead situated east of the Ruins of Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands. Once fertile land that fed Lordaeron, it has been seized by the Scourge and transformed into a toxic spreading ground for plague vapors.

sections.title: A Field of Disease
sections.body: Like many of the old human homesteads surrounding Andorhal, the farmstead now called the Writhing Haunt fell swiftly during the Third War. Today, the fields do not grow crops but instead harvest rot. The Scourge planted an enormous plague cauldron squarely in the center of the tilled earth, continuously venting noxious, diseased vapors into the air. Rotting ghouls, freezing ghouls, and fetid zombies wander the overgrown furrows, guarding the machinery under the command of Cauldron Lord Razarch.

sections.title: A Watcher in the Ruins
sections.body: Despite the omnipresent danger of the Scourge and the choking miasma from the cauldron, the farm is not entirely abandoned. Inside one of the dilapidated farmhouses lingers Mulgris Deepriver, a tauren druid who came to these lands to heal the damage done to nature. Stricken by the plague himself and unable to cure the suffering beasts, he asks capable travelers to grant the diseased wolves and other wildlife a swift and merciful release.

faq.q: What was the Writhing Haunt before the plague?
faq.answer: Before the Third War, the Writhing Haunt was a productive, life-sustaining human farm that helped supply grain and livestock to nearby Andorhal and the greater Kingdom of Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why is there a giant cauldron in the middle of the field?
faq.answer: The cauldron was placed by the Scourge to actively brew and disperse plague vapors across the surrounding countryside, poisoning the soil, the water, and any living creatures nearby.

aliases: who is in charge writhing haunt
faq.answer: The site is commanded by Cauldron Lord Razarch, an undead servant of the Scourge who guards the plague cauldron alongside a host of ghouls and zombies.

faq.q: Who is hiding in the farmhouse?
faq.answer: Mulgris Deepriver, a tauren druid, shelters inside the abandoned farmhouse. He came to the Plaguelands to heal the damage done to nature, and since the plague cannot be cured, he asks travelers to put the region's diseased wildlife out of its misery.

angles.text: The desecration of rich farming soil by plague vapors makes the Writhing Haunt an active offense against the natural order, demanding that the cauldron be silenced.
Seeing the farmland outside Andorhal reduced to a diseased wasteland under Scourge rule is a bitter reminder of the fall of Lordaeron.
